verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents an official, modular Python SDK with an API reference covering zero-config auto-instrumentation, tracing decorators and span querying. It also documents client SDKs for syncing prompts across environments and an official npm-distributed CLI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-Python SDKs (a TypeScript/JS SDK is only implied by the npm CLI), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a published OpenAPI spec.
